title: Grid foundations
text: examples use deliberately coarse global grid render quickly.
code: config <- priogrid::pg_config(   nrow = 18,   ncol = 36,   start_date = as.Date("2020-12-31"),   end_date = as.Date("2021-12-31"),   temporal_resolution = "1 year",   verbose = FALSE )

title: Grid foundations
text: pg_id_from_coords() assigns longitude-latitude coordinates configured cells. Coordinates outside regional grid return NA default. Cell centres can recovered requested coordinate reference system.
code: cells <- pg_id_from_coords(   longitude = c(10, 20),   latitude = c(50, 60),   config = config ) cells #> [1] 488 525 pg_coords_from_id(cells, config = config) #>   pgid xcoord ycoord #> 1  488     15     45 #> 2  525     25     55

title: Grid foundations
text: Use pg_geometry() create polygons mapping points distance nearest-feature operations.
code: cell_polygons <- pg_geometry(cells, config = config) cell_centres <- pg_geometry(cells, geometry = "point", config = config) cell_centres #> Simple feature collection with 2 features and 1 field #> Geometry type: POINT #> Dimension:     XY #> Bounding box:  xmin: 15 ymin: 45 xmax: 25 ymax: 55 #> Geodetic CRS:  +proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs #>   pgid      geometry #> 1  488 POINT (15 45) #> 2  525 POINT (25 55)

title: Grid foundations
text: Validation reports missing unknown IDs, missing time values, duplicate panel keys, —requested—absent cell-time combinations. pg_complete_panel() makes missing combinations explicit. Fill values applied rows created function; existing NA values left unchanged.
code: observations <- data.frame(   pgid = cells,   year = c(2020L, 2020L),   events = c(3L, 1L) )  pg_validate_data(   observations,   time = "year",   config = config ) #> PRIO-GRID validation: valid #> Rows: 2; observed cells: 2 #>                 check    severity   n #>  missing_combinations information 646 panel <- pg_complete_panel(   observations,   time = "year",   cells = cells,   times = 2020:2021,   fill = list(events = 0L),   config = config ) panel #>   pgid year events #> 1  488 2020      3 #> 2  525 2020      1 #> 3  488 2021      0 #> 4  525 2021      0

title: Grid foundations
text: default relationship many--one: right-hand table must contain one row inferred grid-time key. State another relationship substantively intended.
code: cell_attributes <- data.frame(   pgid = cells,   region = c("A", "B") )  panel <- pg_join(panel, cell_attributes, by = "pgid") panel #>   pgid year events region #> 1  488 2020      3      A #> 2  525 2020      1      B #> 3  488 2021      0      A #> 4  525 2021      0      B

title: Converting NetCDF data
text: Using SpatRaster makes example independent platform-specific NetCDF drivers exercising complete conversion path. Supply explicit dates object contain reliable time metadata:
code: config <- priogrid::pg_config(   nrow = 18,   ncol = 36,   temporal_resolution = "1 year",   start_date = as.Date("2020-12-31"),   end_date = as.Date("2021-12-31"),   verbose = FALSE )  precipitation <- terra::rast(   nrows = 18,   ncols = 36,   nlyrs = 2,   xmin = -180,   xmax = 180,   ymin = -90,   ymax = 90,   crs = "EPSG:4326" ) terra::values(precipitation) <- cbind(   rep(10, terra::ncell(precipitation)),   rep(12, terra::ncell(precipitation)) ) precipitation_pg <- pg_from_netcdf(   x = precipitation,   variable = "precipitation",   aggregation = "mean",   time = c(2020, 2021),   config = config )  head(precipitation_pg)

title: Converting NetCDF data
text: file contains one main variable, pass path directly: files multiple subdatasets, identify required one source_variable: Inspect available subdatasets terra::sds() file metadata choosing source_variable.
code: precipitation_pg <- pg_from_netcdf(   x = "data/raw/precipitation.nc",   variable = "precipitation",   aggregation = "mean",   config = config ) temperature_pg <- pg_from_netcdf(   x = "data/raw/climate.nc",   source_variable = "temperature",   variable = "temperature",   aggregation = "mean",   layer = 1:12,   config = config )

title: Converting NetCDF data
text: valid time metadata present, function uses automatically. Otherwise, supply one time value per selected layer. layer argument can select layers position name time validation. Use na_values encoded missing values: Choose aggregation disaggregation rules according whether variable continuous, cumulative, categorical. See vignette("pg_from_raster", package = "priogridR") detailed guidance.
